title: plan-build output
description: A BuildPlan (docs/BUILDS.md §3): what an unattended agent will build from a paper's core ideas, milestone by milestone, each milestone one Conventional Commit. Every key is always present; `out_of_scope`, `risks` and `questions` may be empty.

summary.description: What the repo will be and how it meets the goal, in two or three sentences.

stack.description: Languages, libraries and tools, the dominant one first ("Python 3.12", "PyTorch", "uv", "pytest").

repo_name.description: A suggested repository name: lowercase, short, says what it is.

milestones.description: In build order; each leaves the repo runnable and lands as one commit (or a few smaller self-contained ones). The seed commit is not a milestone.

commit.description: The Conventional Commit subject that will land it.

deliverable.description: What exists after this commit that did not before: files, functions, a command that runs.

done_when.description: One observable check: a command and what it shows, or a test that passes.

layout.description: The files and folders the finished repo will have, each with its purpose.

out_of_scope.description: Parts of the paper, or of a fuller build, deliberately left out.

risks.description: What could stop the build or make it mislead, each with its mitigation.

questions.description: What the planner would ask the reader before building; each states the default the plan assumes.
